extension_description.message: Εμποδίζει τις σελίδες να χρησιμοποιούν το κλικ σου για να ανοίξουν ή να ανακατευθύνουν κάπου που δεν ζήτησες.

app_title.description: Title shown in the container app and the popup.

popup_guard_label.description: Label of the master on/off switch.

popup_guard_on.description: State of the master switch when the guard is running.

popup_guard_off.description: State of the master switch when the guard is paused.

popup_watch_label.description: Label of the per-site switch, the popup's first row.

popup_no_site_title.description: Popup title on a tab with no website, such as the Start Page.

popup_no_site_body.message: Άνοιξε έναν ιστότοπο και πάτα εδώ.
popup_no_site_body.description: Popup line under popup_no_site_title; 'here' is the toolbar button.

popup_watch_unknown.description: Shown when the current tab has no site to watch.

popup_watch_everywhere.message: Ήδη ενεργή παντού, από τις Ρυθμίσεις.
popup_watch_everywhere.description: Shown when the mode setting already covers every site.

popup_watch_master_off.description: Shown when the master Guard switch in Settings is off.

mode_watched.description: Mode: the guard runs only on sites switched on individually.

mode_everywhere.description: Mode: the guard runs automatically on every site.

popup_page_off.message: Δεν καταγράφεται τίποτα: η προστασία είναι ανενεργή εδώ.
popup_page_off.description: Shown in the tab section when the site is not being guarded.

popup_page_heading.description: Heading of the section about the current tab.

popup_page_quiet.message: Μέχρι στιγμής τίποτα δεν προσπάθησε να φύγει από αυτή τη σελίδα.
popup_page_quiet.description: Shown when no cross-site destination was recorded.

popup_page_empty.message: Δεν υπάρχει ακόμη τίποτα να εμφανιστεί.
popup_page_empty.description: Shown when the destination list is empty.

popup_stopped_one.description: How many attempts were blocked on this page, singular.

popup_stopped_other.description: How many attempts were blocked on this page, plural.

popup_seen_one.description: How many cross-site attempts were recorded, singular.

popup_seen_other.description: How many cross-site attempts were recorded, plural.

popup_tries_one.description: How many times one destination came up, singular.

popup_tries_other.description: How many times one destination came up, plural.

popup_recipe_heading.description: Heading for a per-site fix that was applied.

state_blocked.description: A destination that is being stopped.

state_allowed.description: A destination that is being let through.

scope_here.description: The rule was set for the current site only.

scope_everywhere.description: The rule was set for every site.

scope_default.description: No rule was set, so the default applies.

action_allow_here.message: Να επιτρέπεται σε αυτόν τον ιστότοπο
action_allow_here.description: Let this destination through on the current site.

action_allow_everywhere.description: Let this destination through on every site.

action_block_here.description: Stop this destination on the current site.

action_block_everywhere.description: Stop this destination on every site.

popup_policy_heading.description: Label above the default policy choice.

policy_block.description: Default policy: stop unknown cross-site destinations.

policy_allow.description: Default policy: let unknown cross-site destinations through.

popup_bridge_warning.message: Οι ρυθμίσεις ασφαλείας αυτής της σελίδας μπλοκάρουν μέρος του script, οπότε η προστασία είναι εδώ μερική.
popup_bridge_warning.description: Shown when the page CSP stopped the page-world script.

kind_click_catcher.description: A transparent form or link laid over the page.

kind_overlay.description: A see-through element covering the page.

kind_synthetic_click.description: A click the page dispatched itself.

kind_form_submit.description: A form submitted to a new tab.

kind_href_swap.message: Σύνδεσμος που άλλαξε εν μέσω κλικ
kind_href_swap.description: An anchor rewritten between press and release.

kind_back_hijack.description: A navigation right after the back gesture.

kind_redirect.description: A cross-site navigation that took the user's press.

kind_pop_tab.description: A new tab the page opened on somewhere else.

kind_network_rule.description: A known pop network refused by a network rule.

reason_way_back.message: Η διεύθυνσή του περιείχε επιστροφή σε αυτόν τον ιστότοπο.
reason_way_back.description: Why a redirect was allowed: its address carried a same-site callback.

reason_sized.description: Why a popup was allowed: the page asked for it at a size, not a bare tab.

reason_took_press.description: Why a destination was blocked: it arrived on a press aimed elsewhere.

reason_default_allow.description: Why a destination was allowed: no rule, and the default policy is allow.

reason_own_code.message: Το άνοιξε ο ίδιος ο ιστότοπος.
reason_own_code.description: Why a window was allowed: the code that opened it belongs to this site.

popup_rules_link.description: Opens the list of every rule the user has set.

popup_page_link.description: Goes back from the rules list to the current tab.

rules_everywhere_heading.description: Heading for rules that apply on every site.

rules_by_site_heading.description: Heading for rules that apply to a single site.

rules_empty.description: Shown when a rules list has no entries.

action_clear.description: Remove a rule so the default applies.

setting_banner.description: Toggle for the note drawn in the page when something is stopped.

action_report.description: Opens a prefilled issue about a site the guard missed.

action_title_off.description: Toolbar button tooltip while the guard is off on the site.

action_title_no_site.message: Δεν υπάρχει τίποτα να προστατευτεί εδώ
action_title_no_site.description: Toolbar button tooltip on a tab with no website, such as the Start Page.

action_title_on.message: Προστασία ενεργή σε αυτόν τον ιστότοπο
action_title_on.description: Toolbar button tooltip while the guard is on.

popup_watch_on.message: Ενεργή. Η απενεργοποίηση ανανεώνει τη σελίδα.
popup_watch_on.description: Under the site name while the guard runs there.

popup_watch_off.message: Ανενεργή. Η ενεργοποίηση ανανεώνει τη σελίδα.
popup_watch_off.description: Under the site name while the guard is off there.

state_removed.description: A trap on the page itself, taken off before it could catch a click.
